full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a small white house standing on a solitary rocky islet in a quiet gray sea beneath an overcast sky. The pale, nearly featureless sky fills the upper half of the frame, its cool light fading gently toward the distant horizon. On the left side of the upper middle area, the house rests close to the crest of the island, appearing modest against the mass of stone below it. Its light walls and subdued greenish roof make a small, crisp geometric shape amid the irregular ground. A dark doorway and a few little window openings interrupt the white facade without turning the building into the main source of detail. The low strip of grass around it is muted olive and brown, thinning where bare rock breaks through. To the right, a higher angular shoulder of stone rises above the grassy crest and gives the island an uneven silhouette. Dark gray rock faces descend steeply toward the water, with wet-looking creases, blunt ledges, and patches of green growth visible across their surface. Along the bottom edge, a rough rocky foreshore extends from the left foreground toward the central water channel, its scattered stones darker than the distant land. The sea is a restrained blue gray with small horizontal ripples and soft reflections of the clouded light. Open water on the right provides room around the island, while the horizon remains low and unobtrusive behind it. The light is broad and diffuse, arriving through cloud cover rather than from a hard visible sun; it leaves shallow shadows in the rock fissures and almost no sharp cast shadows around the house. The photographic surface is natural and lightly grainy, with detailed stone in the foreground and a gentle loss of contrast through the distant air. The overall composition balances a tiny pale shelter against a broad dark rock form, using cool muted color and generous empty sky to create a remote, weathered stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一座小白屋，立在灰色静海中孤独的岩礁上，头顶是阴云密布的天空。浅色、几乎没有明显形状的天空占据画面上半部，冷调光线向远处地平线缓缓减弱。画面中上部偏左，小屋靠近岛屿顶端，和下方厚重的岩体相比显得很小。浅色墙面与低调的灰绿色屋顶在不规则地面间形成一个小而清晰的几何形体。深色门洞和几处小窗打断白墙，却没有使建筑成为细节最密集的部分。屋旁低矮的草地呈暗橄榄绿和棕色，在裸露岩石穿出的地方逐渐变薄。右侧更高的棱角状石脊突出草地，使岛屿轮廓参差起伏。深灰岩壁陡然落向水面，表面可见潮湿似的裂纹、钝圆的岩层突起和零星绿色植被。画面底缘，粗砺的岩石前滩从左侧前景延向中央水道，散落的石块比远处陆地更暗。海水是克制的蓝灰色，带有细小的水平波纹和阴天光线的柔和反射。右侧开阔水面在岛屿周围留出空间，地平线在后方保持低矮而不抢眼。光穿过云层宽广地漫射，并非来自清晰可见的烈日；它只在岩石裂隙里留下浅阴影，小屋周围几乎没有清晰投影。照片表面自然且略带细微颗粒，前景石质细节明确，远方空气则令对比度温和减弱。整体构图以微小的浅色居所平衡宽阔的深色岩体，用冷淡的低饱和色和大片空白天空营造偏远、受风雨侵蚀的静谧感。
style_prompt_en: The color photograph favors patient, documentary observation and a cool, subdued tonal range. Large fields of pale gray are set against dense charcoal masses, so a small light shape can hold attention without a theatrical spotlight. Irregular edges and weathered surfaces carry more information than decorative detail; their texture remains crisp near the viewer and softens gradually with distance. Muted olive, blue gray, brown, and off-white remain close in saturation, giving color a quiet supporting role beside the stronger value contrast. Cloud-filtered light spreads broadly across the scene, leaving shallow creases of shadow and restrained highlights rather than hard directional beams. Broad negative space surrounds a compact, asymmetrical center of visual weight, while low horizontal bands stabilize the rough vertical contours. Slight atmospheric haze reduces contrast at depth without erasing foreground grain. The overall effect is remote and contemplative, grounded in natural surface detail and the measured scale of a small bright accent within a larger dark form.
style_prompt_zh: 这类彩色摄影偏向耐心的纪实观察和冷淡、克制的调子。大片浅灰色区域与浓重炭黑色块相对，使一个小小的亮形无需戏剧性聚光也能吸引视线。不规则边缘与受风化的表面比装饰细节承载更多信息；其肌理在近处清晰，随距离增加逐渐柔化。暗橄榄绿、蓝灰、棕色和灰白色的饱和度相近，让色彩在更强的明度对比旁安静地发挥辅助作用。云层过滤的光均匀铺展，留下浅浅的纹理阴影和克制的高光，而非坚硬的定向光束。宽广留白环绕一个紧凑且不对称的视觉重心，低矮的水平色带稳定粗糙的竖向轮廓。轻微空气雾感降低远处对比，却不抹掉前景颗粒。整体效果偏远而沉思，以自然表面细节和大块深色中一处小亮点的审慎尺度关系为基础。
theme_en: A small white house on an isolated rocky islet beneath an overcast sky
theme_zh: 阴云天空下孤立岩礁上的白色小屋
name: Corey Arnold
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
